_comments.ownerRepo: GitHub owner/name for issue API calls. null = detect from `git remote get-url origin`. Override with env FEATURE_TASK_OWNER_REPO if needed.
_comments.issueTypeFeature: GitHub issue type name used for parent Feature issues.
_comments.issueTypeTask: GitHub issue type name used for child Task sub-issues.
_comments.taskTitlePrefix: Fallback Task detection when issue type is missing: titles starting with this prefix count as Tasks.
_comments.defaultAssignee: GitHub login assigned on every new Task. null = use `gh api user` (authenticated login).
_comments.projectTitle: GitHub Projects V2 title to add each new Task to. null = do not add to a project.
_comments.doneStatusId: Optional GitHub planning-status node ID for Done. null = close the Task with reason completed only.
_comments.closeTaskOnDone: If true, close the Task issue after a successful commit (always used when doneStatusId is unset).
_comments.requireCommitApproval: If true, agents cannot commit alone: Cursor asks for approval; Cline blocks until the user confirms commit intent.
_comments.stateFile: Runtime path for the active Feature/Task (local, feature-specific, should be gitignored).
_comments.logFile: Optional workflow log path (local; should be gitignored).
